description: Straßennetz, Stadt Leipzig is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.leipzig.de. The road network of the city of Leipzig. The dataset includes the street names, from and to sections, districts of the sections, the affiliation to the classified network (federal, state, district road), the type of road (local road, dirt road, etc.), the development (main, secondary, residential network), the building load carrier and the length in ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Road network, City of Leipzig" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include LeipziGIS, Verkehr, opendata, Planung, Geobasisdaten, GeoSN. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
